[b]STEAM NEXT FEST ROADMAP[/b]
Join the ASSAULT SECTOR demo during Steam Next Fest and be part of the action! Test the latest updates, experience intense combat, and help shape the game with your feedback. Check out our Roadmap to see what’s coming next as we continue to improve and expand ASSAULT SECTOR!
[list]
[*] [b]Event Date:[/b] [u]Feb 24[/u] to [u]Mar 3[/u]. Get ready to jump into action!
[*] [b]Server Regions:[/b] North America, Europe, Canada, Asia
[*] [b]Next Event: [/b]Will be announced here. Stay tuned for details!
[*] [b]Try the Latest Build:[/b] Experience new updates, balancing tweaks, and gameplay improvements.
[*] [b]Provide Your Feedback:[/b] Help shape the future of Assault Sector by sharing your thoughts.
[*] [b]Join the Community:[/b] Connect with other players, discuss strategies, and share your experiences.

[/list]
